scene.ko: 친구에게 빌린 카메라의 렌즈에 흠집을 냈다. 무슨 일이 있었는지 솔직히 설명하고 수리를 책임지겠다고 한다.

lines.en: Hey, Lauren. Thanks again for lending me your camera. Um, before I give it back, I need to tell you something.
lines.ko: 로렌, 카메라 빌려줘서 다시 한번 고마워. 음, 돌려주기 전에 말할 게 있어.
alt: Lauren, thanks for letting me borrow your camera. But first, there's something I have to tell you.

lines.en: Uh-oh. That doesn't sound good. What happened?
On the last day of the trip, I was changing lenses on a windy beach, and I dropped the lens on a rock. There's a scratch on it now.
lines.ko: 여행 마지막 날 바람 부는 바닷가에서 렌즈를 바꾸다가 바위에 떨어뜨렸어. 그래서 렌즈에 흠집이 났어.
alt: I dropped the lens on a rock when I was switching lenses at the beach on the last day. Now it has a scratch.

lines.en: Oh no. That lens was a gift from my dad.
lines.ko: 아, 안 돼. 그 렌즈 아빠가 선물해 주신 건데.

lines.en: I know, and I feel terrible. It was totally my fault. I should've changed it in the car, not out in the wind.
lines.ko: 알아, 그래서 너무 미안해. 완전히 내 잘못이야. 바람 부는 밖에서 말고 차 안에서 바꿨어야 했는데.
alt: I know, and I'm so sorry. It's completely my fault. I shouldn't have changed it outside in the wind.

lines.en: Well... at least you told me right away. Does it still work?
lines.ko: 음... 그래도 바로 말해 줘서 다행이다. 작동은 돼?

lines.en: It still works, and the photos look okay, but the scratch is pretty visible. I already called a repair shop, and they can replace the front glass. I'll pay for it, of course.
lines.ko: 작동은 되고 사진도 괜찮은데, 흠집이 꽤 눈에 띄어. 벌써 수리점에 전화해 봤는데 앞 유리를 갈 수 있대. 비용은 당연히 내가 낼게.
alt: It works fine, but you can really see the scratch. I've already talked to a repair shop. They can replace the front glass, and I'll cover the cost.

lines.en: You didn't have to do all that. But thanks. That actually makes me feel a lot better.
lines.ko: 그렇게까지 안 해도 되는데. 그래도 고마워. 그 말 들으니까 마음이 훨씬 놓인다.

lines.en: It's the least I can do. I'll drop it off tomorrow and bring it back as soon as it's ready.
lines.ko: 그 정도는 당연히 해야지. 내일 맡기고, 다 되면 바로 갖다줄게.
alt: That's the least I can do. I'll take it to the shop tomorrow and return it as soon as it's fixed.

lines.en: Okay. And hey, I still want to see your trip photos!
lines.ko: 알았어. 그리고 있잖아, 여행 사진은 꼭 보여 줘!

expressions.en: I need to tell you something.
I'll pay for it, of course.
expressions.note: cover the cost 도 같은 뜻

expressions.en: It's the least I can do.
